shard.title: battery: battery-mustdoc
shard.basis: members of group battery-mustdoc (origin rule) in the current release (7224r3a)

name: mustdoc
label: X should be forced to be examined at a clinic by law

questions.text:
Some cities and states have laws that force people with problems like NAME into treatment. Do you think that people like NAME should be forced by law to... 
A. Get treatment at a clinic or from a doctor.
questions.stem: Some cities and states have laws that force people with problems like NAME into treatment. Do you think that people like NAME should be forced by law to...
questions.item: A. Get treatment at a clinic or from a doctor.
